verdict.rationale: Rive offers several programmatic paths into editor work. Its official MCP server exposes Editor tools for View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes. RML is a text format for creating and modifying Rive files as code, and a CLI lets agents generate content. However, the MCP docs call this only a 'first set of tools' for repetitive tasks, nothing documents parity with the full Editor, and no public OpenAPI/REST API was found. Missing for 10: documented API/UI parity across all Editor features (timelines, keyframes, scripting, assets, export, revision history), a general public API spec, independent hands-on confirmation of RML/CLI/MCP coverage.
